name: Shukra Jewellery Limited
about: Shukra Jewellery Limited manufactures and sells diamond studded gold jewelry in India. It operates through Diamonds and Gold Jewellery; and Real Estate Business segments. The company also trades in cut and polished diamonds; undertakes construction work; and develops and sells residential flat schemes. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shukra Diamond Exports Limited and changed its name to Shukra Jewellery Limited in January 1997. Shukra Jewellery Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
